content: Lunch is served from 11:30 to 14:30; Dinner is served from 17:00 to 21:00.
Last call for food and drinks is 30 minutes before closing, at 21:00.
100 University Road, Nanzih District, Kaohsiung (高雄市楠梓區大學路100號).
07-123-4567. Our staff answer the phone every day from 10:30 to 21:00.
We accept cash, credit cards, and mobile payments (Line Pay / Apple Pay).
Set Meal upgrade: Any main course + NT$120 includes soup, daily salad, and a drink.
Students with a valid student ID get 10% off on all set meals.
We do not offer direct delivery. Delivery is available via Uber Eats and foodpanda.
No private car park. Scooters park in front; cars use the paid public lot 100m behind (NT$30/hr).
